Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals threatening damage and knocks you up, so when you see it cast, dodge outside or inside the blade’s sweet spot. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, immediately leave its area before you get pulled back. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing increases, so stop dueling and create distance.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If long duels are common, build anti-healing next. Consider penetration if Aatrox’s high armor makes Dr. Mundo’s physical damage ineffective.
Aatrox.fight: Take a short trade just after Aatrox uses his empowered Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance attack on a minion, or just after Aatrox E Umbral Dash is on cooldown. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade combo lands, dodge the blade’s sweet spot, then retaliate with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Don’t fight back while Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, focus on surviving and farming rather than getting kills. Keep the lane by hitting minions with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw to heal. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases’ canister drops, prioritize collecting it over continuing the trade. Don’t push the lane forward when your passive is down and the enemy jungler is missing.
Aatrox.escape: Just after making Aatrox use Aatrox E Umbral Dash is a chance to close the gap with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Go in when the crowd control from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade or Aatrox W Infernal Chains has been spent, and be more cautious about getting caught if Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is unavailable. Dr. Mundo has no mobility spell to escape on his own, so if Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, immediately walk out of its area.
Aatrox.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo benefits from avoiding Aatrox’s kill pressure and farming. His staying power improves greatly from mid game, once Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and his first core item are ready. In the late game, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma gains more attack damage as he builds health items, so make use of his scaling strength.
Aatrox.teamfight: After Aatrox dives onto an ally, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in. Slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and pressure them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Aatrox R World Ender is active, don’t duel him for long; wait for its duration to end.
Aatrox.combo: Use Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw from an angle where minions won’t block it to slow Aatrox and close in. Just before Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade hits, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, then land Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack in basic attack range. When Aatrox is within the blast radius, recast W to restore the stored health.

Akali.watch: Once marked, Akali’s second dash will follow even if you try to escape, so if you’re hit, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Akali goes in.
Akali.build: Rush Spirit Visage early to build magic resistance. Akali’s main damage is magic, and Spirit Visage also increases the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, W Heart Zapper, and R Maximum Dosage.
Akali.fight: Fight back when Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to engage. Slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in, but activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Akali’s attack lands. Don’t chase far if Akali still has several ways to escape.
Akali.laning: Early on, prioritize farming and surviving over getting kills, and keep the lane with the hit healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Bonesaw is blocked by minions, so choose whether to throw it at Akali or at a minion to heal. Time your recall after pushing the wave toward the enemy turret.
Akali.combo: Slow Akali with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, then activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before she retaliates and close in to land an empowered Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma attack. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal the stored health while Akali is inside the explosion radius. You can aim Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw at Akali when she briefly appears as she enters Akali W Twilight Shroud.
Akali.escape: Don’t go deep just because Akali W Twilight Shroud or E Shuriken Flip is on cooldown. She can escape with her remaining mobility, so look for an opening especially before Akali R Perfect Execution is back up.
Akali.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo should focus on farming and surviving rather than applying kill pressure.
Akali.teamfight: After Akali dives onto an ally, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in. Slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. When absorbing Akali’s attacks, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before they land, then recast it to heal while enemy champions are nearby.

Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses a wall to engage from range and stun you, so stand away from walls. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s second empowered basic attack includes true damage, so it’s best to create distance while she prepares it to avoid being hit. If you’re trapped in Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, don’t use a response ability at the moment she engages; hold out until the zone ends, then retaliate.
Camille.build: Build armor first to account for Camille’s main damage. However, armor won’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and building only health also increases the damage from Camille W Tactical Sweep, so don’t focus solely on health.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield activates; fight after it has been removed. When Camille engages, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before her combo to store damage, then recast it while she’s inside the explosion radius to heal. If your health is low and you’re using Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage, don’t wait too long under the assumption that its healing will save you immediately.
Camille.combo: After Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield has been removed, slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Camille’s retaliation lands, then use Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma to land an empowered basic attack at basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Camille is in range.
Camille.escape: A good window to engage is after Camille E Hookshot is on cooldown and before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is back up.
Camille.phase: Dr. Mundo has low kill pressure early, so hold on and farm. In the late game, Dr. Mundo’s health items also add attack damage to Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, but Camille can quickly take down turrets in a side lane from mid game onward, so don’t leave the side lane unattended.
Camille.teamfight: Rather than starting the teamfight, wait until Camille dives onto an ally, then activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases activates on Camille E Hookshot and drops a canister, look for a chance to collect it instead of continuing the fight.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when its curse is drawn back, and that damage increases the more health you’ve lost. If you’re cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself; if your health is low, retreat before the curse is drawn back. You’ll be slowed if you leave after Aurora R Between Worlds is cast, so decide whether to leave before the area appears.
Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, and Dr. Mundo has low magic resistance early, so rush Spirit Visage. Building magic resistance first helps you withstand her damage, and Spirit Visage’s increased healing works well with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, W Heart Zapper, and R Maximum Dosage.
Aurora.fight: Look for a chance to close in just after Aurora uses her abilities on the wave or when your jungler is ganking. Once Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding are both used, her options for escape are greatly reduced, so keep trading then. Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage can heal you when your health is low, but leave enough time to cast it before you take the recast damage from Aurora Q Twofold Hex.
Aurora.laning: Early on, farm behind minions rather than chasing Aurora into Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw range. Use Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw on minions to heal, and prioritize collecting a canister dropped by Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases. Time your recall after the wave has pushed toward the enemy turret.
Aurora.combo: Slow Aurora with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, then close in and activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Aurora’s retaliation lands. Use an empowered Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma basic attack at basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal the stored health while Aurora is inside the explosion radius.
Aurora.escape: Don’t go in immediately just because Aurora E The Weirding is on cooldown. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and the enemy jungler is missing, don’t move forward.
Aurora.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo should focus on surviving and farming rather than applying kill pressure. In the late game, his Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma attack damage increases more as he builds health items.
Aurora.teamfight: After Aurora dives onto an ally, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Aurora used her leap to engage and no one was killed, that’s a chance to close in. If an ally is killed, Aurora can use Aurora W Across the Veil again, so don’t leave low-health allies behind when retreating.

Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you’re vulnerable to follow-up attacks, so harass from outside its range. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases blocks the first immobilizing effect but still costs health, so it may be better to pick up the dropped canister first. If many stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage have built up, create distance to break the stacks, and get completely out of Darius R Noxian Guillotine range.
Darius.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Darius P Hemorrhage, Darius Q Decimate, and Darius W Crippling Strike. Darius E Apprehend penetrates some armor, and you can’t reduce the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine with resistances, so build health too. If Dr. Mundo’s physical damage is ineffective against Darius’s high armor, consider adding penetration.
Darius.fight: Trade briefly when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown, then back off before Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up. When Darius Q Decimate is coming, move outside the blade’s edge or stay right next to him to reduce its damage and healing. The moment after Darius Q Decimate is used to clear minions is also a chance to harass.
Darius.laning: Early on, focus on surviving and farming outside Darius E Apprehend range rather than looking for a kill. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw can heal you even when it hits a minion, so decide whether you’re aiming to harass or heal before throwing it. Don’t push the lane forward if the enemy jungler is missing and Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is on cooldown.
Darius.combo: After Darius E Apprehend is used, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and approach. Just before his follow-up attack lands, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, then use Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma to empower a basic attack within melee range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Darius is within its explosion radius.
Darius.escape: Go in when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is on cooldown, you can’t block the pull, so delay your engage. Immediately create distance if Darius P Hemorrhage stacks start building up.
Darius.phase: Early on, farm and survive because Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure and Darius is strong in skirmishes. As you build health items later, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma also gains attack damage.
Darius.teamfight: Rather than starting the fight yourself, wait until Darius engages an ally, then activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk toward the enemy carry. Slow them with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Darius kills you with Darius R Noxian Guillotine while Darius P Hemorrhage is stacked, its cooldown resets, so get out of range when your health is low.

Gangplank.watch: When Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, move out of its blast radius, and don’t stand where two barrels overlap. If a barrel is placed nearby, destroy it from outside its range. Keep in mind that armor can’t block the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and R Cannon Barrage.
Gangplank.build: Build armor early in lane to withstand Gangplank Q Parrrley harass. Also build up your health to prepare for the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and R Cannon Barrage.
Gangplank.fight: Trade right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed or immediately after a barrel is destroyed. Slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in, but activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before his attack lands.
Gangplank.laning: Early on, don’t force a kill. Farm while making use of the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits. Back off when Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, and time your recall after pushing the wave toward the enemy turret.
Gangplank.combo: The moment Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and approach. Just before Gangplank’s damage lands, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, then land a basic attack empowered by Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Gangplank is within its explosion radius.
Gangplank.escape: The moment Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed or after you destroy one is your chance to engage. Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, but back off first if a primed barrel is nearby.
Gangplank.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure, so survive and farm. As you build health items later, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma also gains attack damage.
Gangplank.teamfight: After the enemy engages an ally, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in. Avoid Gangplank’s primed E Powder Keg, slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.

Chogath.watch: When the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture appears beneath you, immediately walk to the side to dodge it. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you from the front, it’s hard to respond to the Q that follows, so avoid facing him head-on. If your health is at or below half, move out of range of the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.
Chogath.build: Build Spirit Visage early and raise your magic resistance to withstand the magic damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. The healing Spirit Visage amplifies works well with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, W Heart Zapper, and R Maximum Dosage. Resistances can’t block the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast, and building only health also increases the damage from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes, which scales with your maximum health.
Chogath.fight: Dodge the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture to the side, or approach right after Cho'Gath uses Q on the wave. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is ready, you can ignore the first immobilizing effect; if it’s on cooldown, keep your distance. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before the enemy combo lands, and use the movement speed from Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage when closing in.
Chogath.laning: Early on, Dr. Mundo should focus on farming and surviving rather than looking for kills, but harass from a safe distance so Cho'Gath can’t stack freely. Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pass through minions, so step out of the line when Cho'Gath is basic attacking. Make use of the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits and Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, and time your recall after pushing the wave toward the enemy turret.
Chogath.combo: After dodging Cho'Gath Q Rupture, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, then use Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma to empower a basic attack. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before the enemy damage lands, then recast it while Cho'Gath is within its explosion radius to recover the stored health.
Chogath.escape: The moment after Cho'Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave is your chance to approach. Avoid the frontal area of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and check that Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is ready before going in. Cho'Gath has no mobility ability and can’t create distance once you’re on him, but Dr. Mundo also has no ability to escape on his own, so don’t engage when you risk being caught by crowd control.
Chogath.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure, so survive and farm. Dr. Mundo also scales later, but Cho'Gath becomes harder to deal with as he stacks up, so apply safe pressure early and avoid being killed by Cho'Gath R Feast.
Chogath.teamfight: Rather than starting the team fight yourself, wait until Cho'Gath engages an ally, then activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Avoid the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture and the frontal area of W Feral Scream while slowing the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attacking with E Blunt Force Trauma. When your health is low, keep your distance with the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast in mind.

Fiora.watch: Watch the direction of Fiora P Duelist's Dance’s vital and stand on the opposite side to limit her attack angles. Fiora W Riposte can negate Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw or E Blunt Force Trauma, so bait out Riposte, then move to the side and attack. If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stay against a wall so she can’t hit all four vitals.
Fiora.build: Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and E Bladework. Resistances can’t reduce the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and R Grand Challenge, and R Grand Challenge scales with your maximum health, so don’t rely on building health alone. If the duel goes on, consider healing reduction after resistances.
Fiora.fight: Early on, trade briefly and back off instead of looking for a kill. After Fiora Q Lunge is used, slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before her attack lands.
Fiora.combo: Bait out Fiora W Riposte first, then slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Just before Fiora’s attack lands, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, then close in and use Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma to empower a basic attack. Recast W Heart Zapper while Fiora is in range.
Fiora.escape: The moment after making Fiora use Q Lunge is your chance to close the distance. Once Fiora W Riposte is on cooldown, it’s easier to land Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and E Blunt Force Trauma. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is on cooldown, don’t chase recklessly, since Fiora W Riposte can slow you.
Fiora.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure, so survive and farm.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stay against a wall to limit her chances to hit all four vitals. After the enemy engages an ally, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in, slowing the enemy carry with Q Infected Bonesaw and attacking with E Blunt Force Trauma.

Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack silences you and prevents Dr. Mundo from fighting back, so don’t engage while Garen has it ready. Garen E Judgment is more dangerous the longer you stay close, so move out of its spin range. If you’re below half health, watch out for Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health, and stay out of range.
Garen.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. However, Garen E Judgment reduces your armor, and resistance doesn’t help against Garen R Demacian Justice, so build some health too and walk out of the spin range.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly immediately after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used on a minion or is otherwise fully spent. Slow Garen with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in, but disengage instead of staying in the fight when Garen E Judgment starts spinning. Don’t unload your attacks right after Garen W Courage activates; wait out the brief shield, then fight back.
Garen.laning: Early on, Dr. Mundo should focus on farming and sustaining with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw’s hit healing rather than forcing kills. Push the lane whenever possible to limit the time Garen has to build stacks on Garen W Courage. Time your recall for after the wave has pushed toward the enemy turret.
Garen.combo: After Garen Q Decisive Strike has been fully spent, slow Garen with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Garen’s attack lands, then hit him with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Garen is within its explosion radius. If Garen W Courage just activated, wait briefly before attacking.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility abilities, so a good window to close in is after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack has been fully spent and Garen E Judgment ends. Avoid engaging while Garen Q Decisive Strike is ready, and stay out of Garen R Demacian Justice’s range if health is below half.
Garen.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure, so farm and survive while limiting the time Garen has to stack Garen W Courage as much as possible. Later, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma grants more attack damage as he builds health items, but Garen’s stacks also grow permanently, making him harder to deal with over time.
Garen.teamfight: After enemies, including Garen, engage your team, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Slow the enemy carries with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and pressure them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack. Choose your moment carefully, since it’s difficult to reach the backline without Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage.

Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit slows and marks you, so dodge it before closing the distance. When Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith, move away instead of fighting near the tentacles, and wait out its duration.
Illaoi.build: Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Q Tentacle Smash, and W Harsh Lesson deal most of her damage as physical damage, so build armor first. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone. When you need to reduce her healing, build Executioner’s Calling first and factor it into your fight.
Illaoi.fight: Immediately after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit and after she has used W Harsh Lesson is Dr. Mundo’s chance to close in. Slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and approach, then activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before her counterattack lands. Don’t let fights drag on near her tentacles.
Illaoi.laning: Early on, focus on last-hitting and surviving rather than looking for kills. Keep the lane away from walls and last-hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. Sustain with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw by hitting minions, and time your recall for after you push the wave toward the enemy turret.
Illaoi.combo: After Illaoi misses E Test of Spirit or uses W Harsh Lesson, slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before her damage lands, then hit her with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack within basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Illaoi is within its explosion radius.
Illaoi.escape: Engage just after Illaoi misses E Test of Spirit and uses W Harsh Lesson. If both skills are still available, don’t approach near her tentacles.
Illaoi.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure, so farm while avoiding Illaoi’s tentacle zones. Later, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma grants more attack damage as he builds health items, but continue avoiding fights near Illaoi’s tentacles.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t group up in front of Illaoi R Leap of Faith; spread out and wait out its duration. Break the tentacles or draw Illaoi away from walls, then engage with Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage when the enemy engages on your allies. Slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and land Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain across low-health minions to close the distance, so back away when minions are close to dying. Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun can be ignored once if Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is active, but be careful to dodge it if your passive is down. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait for the blades to disappear.
Irelia.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and W Defiant Dance. Since basic attacks and attack speed are also key to her damage, reducing her attack speed can help.
Irelia.fight: Close the distance just after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Irelia’s attack lands, slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, then hit her with a basic attack empowered by Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If health has decreased, consider Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage’s immediate and sustained healing as you continue fighting.
Irelia.laning: Early on, focus on farming and use Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw’s healing rather than forcing kills. Don’t leave a half-health minion between you and Irelia that she can dash to, and step back when minions are close to dying. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and the enemy jungler is missing, don’t push the lane forward.
Irelia.combo: Hit Irelia with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw from an angle that isn’t blocked by minions to slow her. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before her attack lands, close to basic attack range, and hit her with a basic attack empowered by Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Irelia is within its explosion radius.
Irelia.escape: Just after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge is Dr. Mundo’s chance to close the distance. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, there’s less need to worry about its stun; also check whether Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is active before engaging.
Irelia.phase: Later in the game, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma grants more attack damage as he builds health items.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and E Flawless Duet have a major impact on teamfights, so prioritize her. After Irelia engages your team, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack her with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.

Gwen.watch: Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage in the center of its cone, so sidestep when she casts it. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid staying in close and taking repeated hits. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you cannot target Gwen from outside the mist, so enter it or wait for it to end.
Gwen.build: Build Spirit Visage early, considering Gwen’s magic damage and Dr. Mundo’s low early magic resistance. The magic resistance helps against Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework, while the increased healing from Spirit Visage works well with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, W Heart Zapper, and R Maximum Dosage. Build armor as well to handle Gwen’s basic attacks, but resistances cannot block the true damage in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.fight: Avoid forcing kills early. Look for short trades before Gwen Q Snip Snip! builds stacks or right after Gwen uses E Skip 'n Slash. Slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw before approaching, and activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before her damage lands. Sidestep the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, then retaliate with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma after health has decreased.
Gwen.combo: After Gwen uses E Skip 'n Slash, slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before she retaliates, then use an empowered basic attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma within basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal the stored health while Gwen is within its blast radius.
Gwen.escape: The moment after you make Gwen use E Skip 'n Slash first is your chance to close the distance. If you have to chase through the slow from Gwen R Needlework, use the movement speed from Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage. If Gwen Q Snip Snip! has full stacks, do not force an engage even during that window.
Gwen.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so farm and hold on, but look for short trades before Gwen Q Snip Snip! builds stacks.
Gwen.teamfight: After the enemy engages on your team, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in. Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and pressure them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If you have to fight Gwen inside Gwen W Hallowed Mist, enter the mist or wait for its duration to end.
Gwen.laning: Gwen needs to basic attack champions to sustain herself, so farm while harassing her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw from outside her attack range. Minions can block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, so check its path before throwing it; if your goal is healing, it’s fine to hit a minion. Pick up the canister dropped by Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases first, and time your recall after pushing the wave toward the enemy turret.

Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike dodges basic attacks and stuns and deals damage based on your maximum health when reactivated. While it is active, do not use a basic attack empowered by Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma; move outside the stun’s range.
Jax.build: Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. If the enemy team’s magic damage is a concern, build Spirit Visage early for magic resistance and increased healing for Dr. Mundo. Jax relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so consider items that reduce his attack speed.
Jax.fight: Use the time after Jax E Counter Strike ends as a trading window. Slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw to approach, and activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before his attack lands. After confirming that Jax E Counter Strike is down, land an empowered basic attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.
Jax.laning: Stay in lane by using the healing from hits with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases. You can pressure Jax while Jax E Counter Strike is down, but do not push the lane forward if your passive is down and the enemy jungler is missing.
Jax.combo: When Jax E Counter Strike is down, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and approach. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before his attack lands, then use an empowered basic attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma within basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal the stored health while Jax is within its blast radius.
Jax.escape: Immediately after you make Jax use Q Leap Strike and after Jax E Counter Strike ends are opportunities for Dr. Mundo to approach. Do not activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage just because you see Jax start Jax E Counter Strike. Move out of stun range, then use the movement speed from Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage to approach again when needed.
Jax.phase: As Dr. Mundo builds health items later in the game, the attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma also increases, but time trades with Jax for when Jax E Counter Strike is down.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, do not group up and get caught in the area stun together. Dr. Mundo should wait for Jax to engage on your team, then activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in instead of starting the teamfight himself. After Jax E Counter Strike expires, slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.

Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow soon, so sidestep out of its line. When Jayce has his hammer out, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. His first basic attack immediately after switching weapons reduces your resistances, so dodge that hit.
Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first to account for the magic damage from Jayce W Lightning Field and Jayce E Thundering Blow. Magic resistance does not block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast. Since Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on your maximum health, build movement speed to get out of its telegraphed range instead of stacking only health.
Jayce.fight: Do not try to engage first early. Fight right after Jayce uses a skill on the wave or when your jungler comes to gank. Once Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close the distance. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Jayce’s attack lands to create an opportunity to heal the damage you take.
Jayce.laning: Farm behind minions and use Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw for healing rather than poke. Move side to side to dodge the straight path of Jayce Q Shock Blast. If health has decreased significantly, do not overstay; clear the wave and return.
Jayce.combo: After Jayce’s leap or the skill he used on the wave is down, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Jayce retaliates, and use an empowered basic attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma once you are in basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Jayce is within its blast radius.
Jayce.escape: The moment after you make Jayce use Q To the Skies! is your window to close the distance. If the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow is also down, use the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw to find a chance to engage.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so farm defensively and hold on with healing from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases and Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Later, as Dr. Mundo builds health items, the attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma also increases, so focus on scaling.
Jayce.teamfight: Wait for Jayce to engage on your team before going in with Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage, rather than starting the fight yourself. The moment Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is spent, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Jayce has low health and armor, so Dr. Mundo’s physical damage is effective when you get on top of him.

Kennen.watch: Kennen stuns you when Kennen P Mark of the Storm reaches three stacks, so move out of range immediately after being hit twice and wait for the stacks to disappear. Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken with minions, and do not stand on top of your allies when Kennen engages with R Slicing Maelstrom.
Kennen.build: Build magic resistance to match Kennen’s damage, and get Spirit Visage early to increase healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, and Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage.
Kennen.fight: Close the distance after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down or right after he uses a skill on the wave. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, you can ignore the first stun and engage. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Kennen’s attack lands.
Kennen.laning: Early on, last-hit behind minions and use Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw for healing rather than poke. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm reaches two stacks, back off briefly. Do not push the lane forward if Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and the enemy jungler is missing.
Kennen.combo: Slow Kennen with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, then use an empowered basic attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma within basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal the stored health while Kennen is within its blast radius.
Kennen.escape: When Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, you have a chance to engage. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, Kennen P Mark of the Storm can stun you, so clear the mark stacks first before going in.
Kennen.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo should avoid Kennen’s ranged poke, hold on, and farm. Dr. Mundo’s sustain increases significantly from the mid game, when Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and his first core item come online. Later, as Dr. Mundo builds health items, the attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma also increases.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, and use vision to block Kennen’s entry path. After Kennen engages on your team, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.

KSante.watch: K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes pulls in and stuns with his next attack once it has stacked. Hitting minions also builds stacks, so watch the counter and step out of range of the empowered attack. When K'Sante W Path Maker is charged, sidestep the direction of the dash. Keep terrain from being directly behind you so K'Sante R All Out cannot knock you into a wall.
KSante.build: Since getting locked down by K'Sante's chain of crowd control is dangerous, consider tenacity first, then build armor. K'Sante W Path Maker's true damage cannot be reduced with resistances, so build health as well. If you want to deal more damage against K'Sante's high armor, add some armor penetration.
KSante.fight: Keep your distance while K'Sante still has crowd control available and poke with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before K'Sante starts his combo, then recast to heal while K'Sante is in the blast radius. K'Sante R All Out lowers his armor, creating an opening to attack, but it also makes his damage and life steal stronger, so don't let him hit you alone for long.
KSante.combo: Slow K'Sante with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, then approach and activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before K'Sante retaliates. Use Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma's empowered attack within basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal the stored health while K'Sante is in its blast radius.
KSante.escape: Don't go in just because K'Sante W Path Maker is down; check whether K'Sante E Footwork and K'Sante R All Out are still available too. In particular, before K'Sante R All Out comes back up, use the window when his lockdown tools and mobility abilities are down to slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and approach. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, you can be locked down by crowd control, so delay your engage.
KSante.phase: In the late game, the more health items Dr. Mundo builds, the more attack damage Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma gains.
KSante.teamfight: After K'Sante engages on your allies, approach with Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage, slow the enemy damage dealers with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. K'Sante R All Out lowers his armor, creating an opportunity to focus him, but it also strengthens his life steal, so it's best for at least one teammate to have a source of Grievous Wounds. Don't let K'Sante keep attacking several people by himself.
KSante.laning: Even if minions block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, it can still heal you, so decide whether you’re using it to harass or heal before throwing it. Consider picking up the canister dropped by Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases as soon as it falls. If your passive has been used and you can’t see the enemy jungler, don’t push the wave forward.

Kayle.laning: Dr. Mundo holds the lane and farms with the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits and Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases.
Kayle.build: Build Spirit Visage early to increase your magic resistance against Kayle’s damage. Its increased healing received also works well with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, and Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage. Avoiding Kayle Q Radiant Blast comes first, since it lowers your resistances if it hits.
Kayle.combo: Slow Kayle with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, close in, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, and land Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack. When Kayle counterattacks, absorb the damage with Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper and recast it to heal when she is within the blast radius. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, hold your attacks and strike again after the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability, but the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast and the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing make it harder to approach. A good time to close in is after she misses Kayle Q Radiant Blast and uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and use the movement speed from Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage if you need to close the distance.
Kayle.fight: Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Kayle’s attack hits, and land Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack when you can close in.
Kayle.teamfight: Find a path to reach Kayle from the side or outside her vision so she does not have time to keep attacking from the backline. After your allies start a fight, engage with Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and slow Kayle with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast lowers Dr. Mundo’s resistances and slows him, so dodge the hit before approaching. When your health is low, watch out for Kayle E Starfire Spellblade’s damage based on your missing health. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t dump your damage into her; attack again after the invulnerability ends.

Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, immediately create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off before taking all four attacks to avoid the fourth attack's max-health damage. Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are also ways for him to engage, so don't relax just because one is down.
Kled.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, Kled W Violent Tendencies, and Kled E Jousting. Armor doesn't block the damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and Kled W Violent Tendencies and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on max health, so be wary of relying only on health. Tenacity and attack speed reduction also help Dr. Mundo, who has no mobility spell.
Kled.fight: In the early game, focus on growing while keeping your distance instead of looking for a kill. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Kled gets on you and starts his combo, and back off before taking all four attacks from Kled W Violent Tendencies. Once Kled's mobility is down, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and retaliate.
Kled.laning: The moment Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you is your window to escape, so immediately create distance; if you can't, move toward the minion wave or your allies. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by minions, but hitting a minion can still heal you, so use it to farm and heal. Kled dismounted from Skaarl also builds Courage by killing minions, so if you knock him off Skaarl, push him out of the lane as much as possible.
Kled.combo: When Kled engages, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before his combo. If he's within reach, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, close in, and use an empowered basic attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Kled is in its blast radius.
Kled.teamfight: Use flank vision to spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s long-range engage in advance. If you can't stop it, keep your formation with a tank in front so your backline doesn't take the charge directly. After Kled engages on your allies, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in to slow the enemy damage dealers with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and hit them with an empowered Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma basic attack.
Kled.escape: Even if Kled E Jousting is down, don’t force an engage if Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is still available. Dodge the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, then close in with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw to slow him during a window when his movement abilities are down. If Dr. Mundo’s passive has been used, you can’t ignore the first immobilizing effect, so be more cautious when engaging.
Kled.phase: Kled is strong early and Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure, so focus on farming without dying. Kled gets weaker after the laning phase and mid game, while Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma gains more attack damage as you build health items in the late game. Avoid giving up an early advantage and play for the long game.

Malphite.watch: Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, making it harder to engage or retreat, so don't start a trade right after it hits. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash that can knock up several people, so don't stand grouped with your allies while you don't know where he is.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force, and build Spirit Visage early. The healing increased by Spirit Visage works well with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, W Heart Zapper, and R Maximum Dosage.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield before trading so you can damage his actual health. If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, don't engage immediately; activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before the enemy's attack lands to store the damage.
Malphite.laning: In the early game, don't force a kill. Stay alive and collect CS using the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and your passive. Poke at short intervals so Malphite P Granite Shield doesn't come back, but don't stay in range of Malphite Q Seismic Shard for long.
Malphite.combo: After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, close in, activate W Heart Zapper, and use an empowered basic attack with E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast W Heart Zapper while Malphite is in its blast radius to recover the stored health.
Malphite.escape: The opportunity to engage comes after Malphite's mobility spell, R Unstoppable Force, is down. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, you can ignore the first immobilizing effect, but if it's down and you can't see the enemy jungler, don't push the lane forward.
Malphite.phase: In the late game, the more health items Dr. Mundo builds, the more attack damage Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma gains.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't knock up several of you, then retaliate as soon as it's down. If the enemy engages on your allies, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in, slow the enemy damage dealers with Q Infected Bonesaw, then attack with E Blunt Force Trauma.

Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike becomes more dangerous as it stacks, so don’t let him farm last hits freely. Nasus W Wither slows movement and attack speed, and Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases cannot block this slow. Avoid direct fights while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, and leave Nasus E Spirit Fire’s area.
Nasus.build: Build armor first to counter Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main source of damage. If magic damage pressure is high, buy Spirit Visage earlier to gain magic resistance and boost the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, W Heart Zapper, and R Maximum Dosage. Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Nasus.fight: When trading, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Nasus Q Siphoning Strike hits, then recast it to heal while Nasus is in the explosion radius. Look for another chance to fight after Nasus R Fury of the Sands ends.
Nasus.laning: Pushing the wave under Nasus’s turret makes it easier for him to stack Q Siphoning Strike. Let the wave come toward your side, sustain with the healing on Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits, and collect CS. Harass Nasus when he has to step forward for a last hit, and call for a jungle gank.
Nasus.combo: Hit Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw from an angle where minions won’t block it, then approach while Nasus is slowed. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Nasus’s counterattack lands, and once you’re in basic attack range, hit him with an empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Nasus is in the explosion radius.
Nasus.escape: A good window to approach is after Nasus W Wither is down and Nasus R Fury of the Sands has ended. Nasus has no skill to create distance, so slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and stick to him. You can also use the movement speed from Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage to engage, but don’t go deep alone while Nasus W Wither is still available.
Nasus.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo should focus on survival and CS rather than kills, while still denying Nasus easy stacks on Q Siphoning Strike. In the late game, Dr. Mundo also gains attack damage on Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma as he builds health items, but Nasus’s stacks last permanently, making him harder to deal with as time goes on.
Nasus.teamfight: Don’t stand in front of Nasus while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active. Keep your distance and wait out its duration. After the opponent closes in on your allies, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and engage, slowing the enemy carries with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attacking them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Move with your team so Nasus W Wither doesn’t catch you alone.

Mordekaiser.watch: Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits, dealing damage over time and granting movement speed, so staying close to him for too long is dangerous. If Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp pulls you in, he can follow with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, so keep your distance in front of him. While Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, do not enter its ultimate range alone expecting help from your allies.
Mordekaiser.build: Mordekaiser’s main abilities deal magic damage, and Dr. Mundo has low magic resistance early, so buy Spirit Visage earlier to raise your magic resistance. Its increased healing received also works well with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, W Heart Zapper, and R Maximum Dosage. Armor is valuable against Mordekaiser’s basic attacks too, but Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Mordekaiser.fight: Early on, choose short trades over extended fights and back off before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. When Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp is down, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, close in, and land an empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Don’t focus your damage right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield activates; wait until it wears down or converts into healing.
Mordekaiser.combo: Slow Mordekaiser with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in, then activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before his attack lands. Once in basic attack range, hit him with an empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, then recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Mordekaiser is in the explosion radius. Back off before the trade lasts long enough to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
Mordekaiser.escape: When Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp is down, you have a chance to engage with the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Mordekaiser has no skill to create distance, but if Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, avoid fighting alone within its range. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, you’ll take the next immobilizing effect, so choose your engages more carefully.
Mordekaiser.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure and low magic resistance, so focus on farming and surviving against Mordekaiser. In the late game, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma gains attack damage as you build health items, but keep Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s damage based on your maximum health in mind and don’t stay close for too long.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Space yourselves so Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp doesn’t pull several allies in together. After the opponent closes in on your allies, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in, slowing the enemy carries with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attacking them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, position yourself so you’re not alone within its range, where your allies can’t help you.

Olaf.build: Build armor first to counter the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. Resistance doesn’t reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, so get health as well. Olaf’s basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, so effects that reduce attack speed also help.
Olaf.fight: Early on, don’t stay in extended fights with Olaf. Harass him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and focus on surviving. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Olaf’s attack lands, then recast it to heal while he’s in the explosion radius. After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and land an empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.
Olaf.laning: Move opposite the direction of Olaf’s thrown axe to stop him from picking up Olaf Q Undertow. Early on, focus on farming rather than looking for kills, using the healing from hits with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases. Time your recall after pushing the wave toward the enemy turret.
Olaf.combo: Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Olaf’s attack lands. Once Olaf R Ragnarok ends, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, close in, and hit him with an empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Olaf is in the explosion radius to recover the stored health.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no skill to create distance, so when Olaf R Ragnarok ends and you have an opening to approach, stick to him with the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Once you’ve prevented him from picking up the Olaf Q Undertow axe, use the opening when it’s harder for him to harass or approach.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so avoid giving up kills, farm, and buy time. In the late game, Olaf becomes relatively weaker, while Dr. Mundo gains more attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma as he builds health items.
Olaf.teamfight: Rather than initiating the teamfight, wait until Olaf closes in on your allies, then activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and engage. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t keep letting him hit you and extend its duration; slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw after it ends. Walk toward the enemy carries and pressure them with empowered basic attacks from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows you and reduces your armor when it hits, so move opposite the direction the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, which armor can’t reduce, so create distance when your health is low and use the healing from Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t rely on the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw; create distance so Olaf can’t hit you and wait out its duration.

Ornn.watch: Near the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture or other terrain, Ornn E Searing Charge can knock you up, so back away toward open space. If you become brittle from the final breath of Ornn W Bellows Breath, keep your distance to avoid its extra damage and long immobilizing effect. When you see Ornn R Call of the Forge God, dodge the ram to the side and move out of the line between it and Ornn.
Ornn.build: Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so don’t focus your resistances on just one type. Dr. Mundo has no mobility skill and can be locked down by Ornn’s chain crowd control, so consider tenacity before resistances. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking a lot of health alone.
Ornn.fight: Early on, farm while keeping your distance with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw rather than forcing a kill. Even if Ornn E Searing Charge is down, don’t go deep while Ornn R Call of the Forge God is still available. Engage and trade with the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw after both mobility options are down and the brittle effect has ended.
Ornn.laning: Stand away from walls and the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to avoid the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge. Farm while making use of the healing from hits with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases. If Ornn is crafting an item in lane and you can safely approach, attack to interrupt him. Time your recall after pushing the wave toward the enemy turret.
Ornn.combo: Avoid the area around the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then slow Ornn with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Ornn’s combo lands, and once you’re in basic attack range, hit him with an empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Ornn is in the explosion radius to recover the stored health.
Ornn.teamfight: When Ornn R Call of the Forge God appears, dodge the ram to the side and move out of the line where Ornn will knock it back. After Ornn commits to an ally, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in, slowing the enemy carries with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attacking them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before the enemy’s damage lands, then detonate it while an enemy champion is in range.
Ornn.phase: Ornn’s damage is low early, but Dr. Mundo also has little kill pressure, so avoid dying and get ahead in CS. As the game goes on, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma gains more attack damage from health items, but pressure Ornn before he builds up items and upgrades for his allies.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so stay out of its range. When you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk outside the landing area.
Pantheon.build: Build armor first to prepare for Pantheon’s main damage, including Pantheon Q Comet Spear and Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. Pantheon has fairly high armor, so consider penetration or damage that makes armor less effective to increase Dr. Mundo’s damage.
Pantheon.fight: Avoid trading blows head-on early and survive with slows and healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Pantheon W Shield Vault hits to store damage, then recast it to heal while Pantheon is in the explosion radius. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, stop attacking from the front and wait for it to end or circle around to the side.
Pantheon.laning: Farm with minions between you and Pantheon to reduce the damage from Pantheon Q Comet Spear’s long-range poke. Even if minions block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, hit a minion with it to maintain your lane if healing is the goal. If the canister from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases drops, prioritize picking it up to heal, and time your recall for after the wave pushes toward the enemy turret.
Pantheon.combo: When Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends or you get to his side, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Pantheon’s counterattack, then land Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack within basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Pantheon is in the explosion radius.
Pantheon.escape: Look for an engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available. Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also a mobility option, so don’t chase too far just because Pantheon W Shield Vault is down. In particular, there is an opportunity before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off later, while Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma gains more attack damage as Dr. Mundo builds health items.
Pantheon.teamfight: After Pantheon engages on an ally, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is aimed at Dr. Mundo, wait for it to end or circle to the side to deal damage.

Poppy.fight: When Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is ready, it can negate Poppy’s first immobilizing effect; when it’s down, keep a stricter distance. Just after Poppy E Heroic Charge is used, slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and walk in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Poppy’s combo lands, then use Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack once you’re in counterattack range.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and walk in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Poppy’s counterattack, then use Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack when she’s within basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Poppy is in the explosion radius.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your window to close the gap. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, Poppy’s immobilizing effect can lock you in place, so choose your engage carefully. Even while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, Dr. Mundo can walk in.
Poppy.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo should focus on surviving and farming rather than pressuring for kills. Later, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma gains more attack damage as Dr. Mundo builds health items.
Poppy.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about choosing items that only add a lot of health. Don’t spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.teamfight: Rather than starting a fight, wait until Poppy engages an ally, then activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in. If you see Poppy R Keeper's Verdict charging, move to the side to avoid being knocked away. Then slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and hit them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so stay in open space and don’t stand with your back to a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, walk out of the zone before the second hit lands. When Poppy R Keeper's Verdict starts charging, move out of its path to the side.

Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, step outside basic attack range to avoid her empowered attack. Stand behind minions to block Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and don’t force an engage while Quinn E Vault is available.
Quinn.build: Consider Frozen Heart first to counter the attack speed increase from Quinn W Heightened Senses. Armor is effective against Quinn’s damage, so build armor rather than magic resistance.
Quinn.fight: Don’t start a fight alone early; trade when Quinn E Vault is down or your allied jungler arrives. Use Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw to slow Quinn and close the gap.
Quinn.laning: Farm while protecting your health from behind minions. Use Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw for healing rather than poke, and farm while Quinn P Harrier is not marking you.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is down, slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper as you close in. Once she’s within basic attack range, land a basic attack empowered by Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, then recast W while Quinn is in the explosion radius.
Quinn.escape: The moment after Quinn uses Quinn E Vault is your chance to approach her. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and the enemy jungler is also missing, don’t move forward.
Quinn.phase: Dr. Mundo is at a disadvantage early because of Quinn’s range, so survive and scale.
Quinn.teamfight: After the enemy engages on an ally, use Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage to go in, slow Quinn or the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.

Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings knocks you airborne at the end of its sequence of dashes, and Riven W Ki Burst stuns.
Riven.build: All of Riven’s damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, prioritize defensive items sooner, and secure health to prepare for her finishing damage.
Riven.fight: Don’t engage first while Riven has all her abilities; manage your distance. When Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, slow her with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and counter briefly. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Riven’s combo lands to absorb the damage.
Riven.laning: Don’t look for an early kill; farm using the on-hit healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and the healing from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by minions, so check your path when targeting Riven. If your passive is down and the enemy jungler is missing, don’t push the lane forward.
Riven.combo: Slow Riven with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, close in, and activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper. At basic attack range, land an empowered attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If you expect Riven to counterattack, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before her combo lands, then recast it to heal while she’s in the explosion radius.
Riven.escape: Look for an engage after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings on minions or uses up its casts to dash, before the ability becomes available again. Also check whether Riven E Valor is available, since she can use it to escape. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, Riven Q Broken Wings can knock you airborne and Riven W Ki Burst can stun you, so avoid engaging.
Riven.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so avoid Riven’s engages and farm. Later, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma gains more attack damage as Dr. Mundo builds health items.
Riven.teamfight: After Riven engages on an ally, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Dr. Mundo has no mobility ability, so use the movement speed increase to walk toward the enemy carry, slow them with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.

Renekton.watch: If Renekton’s Fury from Renekton P Reign of Anger is near or above half, stay out of range to avoid the stun from his empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice can use minions to reach a second dash, so don’t stand in or behind a minion wave.
Renekton.fight: Trade after Renekton runs out of Fury or spends his abilities. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Renekton’s combo lands to store damage, then recast it when Renekton is in range of the explosion to heal. After health has decreased, counterattack with the empowered attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.
Renekton.laning: Early on, don’t rush for a kill. Farm while making use of the healing from hitting Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and the healing from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases. Harass Renekton when he steps toward the minions to build Fury, but don’t stand behind minions he can use as a launch point for Renekton E Slice and Dice. Time your recall for after the wave pushes toward the enemy turret.
Renekton.combo: When Renekton is out of Fury or Renekton E Slice and Dice is on cooldown, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Renekton’s counterattack, then land the empowered attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma within basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Renekton is in the explosion’s range.
Renekton.escape: Immediately after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage, you have a chance to close the gap. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also on cooldown, you have less reason to worry about its stun, so follow up with the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw.
Renekton.teamfight: After Renekton engages on an ally, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk toward the enemy carries. Slow a carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and hit them with the empowered attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.
Renekton.build: Build armor first to withstand the main damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. The Fury-empowered recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces your armor, so position yourself to dodge that dash before investing in more resistances.
Renekton.phase: Focus on scaling as the game passes the midgame and Renekton’s value falls off. As Dr. Mundo builds health items, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s attack damage bonus also grows.

Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter and Rumble P Junkyard Titan deal damage based on your maximum health, so minimize the time Rumble stays on top of you. If you’re hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, immediately create distance to avoid the second harpoon’s stronger slow and magic resistance reduction. Watch out for the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer as well.
Rumble.build: Dr. Mundo has low magic resistance early, so build Spirit Visage early to raise it. It also increases healing received, which works well with the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, and Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage. Since Rumble Q Flamespitter and Rumble P Junkyard Titan deal damage based on your maximum health, choose defensive items with magic resistance instead of stacking health alone.
Rumble.fight: Avoid trades where you take Rumble Q Flamespitter for too long. Harass with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw from a distance that forces Rumble to step forward. If Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, wait briefly for it to expire before engaging. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Rumble’s damage lands, then counterattack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma after health has decreased.
Rumble.laning: Early on, focus on farming while keeping your distance instead of looking for a kill. You can hit a minion with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw to heal, so choose whether to use it for harass or healing. Hold the lane with healing from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases and Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and time your recall for after you push the wave toward the enemy turret.
Rumble.combo: Wait out the brief shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield, then slow Rumble with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Rumble’s damage lands, then hit him within basic attack range with the empowered attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Rumble is in the explosion’s range to recover the stored health.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so engage after the movement speed boost from Rumble W Scrap Shield ends. However, if you’re hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, stop your engage and immediately create distance to dodge the second harpoon. Slow Rumble with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw before engaging.
Rumble.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so farm and survive without staying in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter for long.
Rumble.teamfight: Rather than starting a teamfight, wait until Rumble engages an ally, then activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in. Watch your distance so you don’t get hit by repeated Rumble E Electro Harpoons. Slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Use Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before taking enemy damage, then recast it while an enemy champion is in the blast radius.

Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there are enemies on both sides of Sett, so position yourself to avoid being caught between Sett and a minion wave. Sett W Haymaker is dangerous right after Grit builds up: create distance after dealing damage, and if he casts it, sidestep the center of its aim to avoid the true damage. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it grabs you, so when Sett has R ready, watch for positions where he can throw you toward your allies.
Sett.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Effects that reduce attack speed are also useful for reducing how many basic attacks you take. Sett Q Knuckle Down scales with your maximum health, and Sett R The Show Stopper scales with the target’s bonus health, so be cautious about choices that add a lot of health alone.
Sett.fight: Early on, focus on scaling while keeping your distance instead of forcing a kill. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Sett starts his combo to store damage, then re-engage after dodging Sett W Haymaker. While Sett R The Show Stopper is on cooldown, look for a chance to close the gap with the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw.
Sett.laning: Sett has several ways to catch you, and Dr. Mundo has no ability to escape on his own, so prioritize managing your distance and farming early. Keep the lane stable by hitting a minion or Sett with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw to heal. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is on cooldown and the enemy jungler is not visible, don’t push the lane forward.
Sett.combo: After Sett uses his threatening abilities, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Sett’s counterattack, then land the empowered attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma within basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Sett is in the explosion’s range to heal.
Sett.escape: The window while Sett R The Show Stopper is on cooldown is your chance to engage. If Sett E Facebreaker is also on cooldown and Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, you can approach with less risk of being caught. If Grit has built up for Sett W Haymaker, create distance and let it cool down before going back in.
Sett.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so survive by farming rather than taking extended fights with Sett. Later, health items increase the attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, but keep in mind that Sett Q Knuckle Down and Sett R The Show Stopper remain threatening because they scale with health.
Sett.teamfight: After Sett engages on an ally, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in. Slow an enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, then attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Avoid standing on opposite sides of Sett from an ally, so Sett E Facebreaker does not stun you both. Also watch for positions where Sett R The Show Stopper can grab you and throw you toward your allies.

Shen.watch: If taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’ll take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash. You can also reduce damage by moving out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault as his spirit blade returns. Save the empowered attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma while Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active.
Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity to mitigate the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so build both types of resistance. Since Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, stacking health alone is inefficient.
Shen.fight: Early on, farm and heal with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw instead of forcing a kill. Immediately after Shen E Shadow Dash misses, slow Shen with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, close in, and counterattack. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is on cooldown and the enemy jungler is not visible, don’t move forward to fight.
Shen.laning: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by minions, so throw it along a clear path when aiming for Shen. If you need healing, hit a minion with it to hold the lane and farm. When you can push, keep Shen occupied with CS to make it costly for him to leave the lane with Shen R Stand United; if he actually uses his ultimate, take advantage of the empty lane.
Shen.combo: If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Shen’s counterattack, then, once Shen W Spirit's Refuge ends and you’re within basic attack range, land the empowered attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Shen is in the explosion’s range to heal.
Shen.phase: Dr. Mundo has low kill pressure early, so it’s better to survive and farm against Shen. Later, health items increase the attack damage gained from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.
Shen.teamfight: Alert your team immediately if Shen disappears from lane or you see the channeling animation for Shen R Stand United, and don’t start a fight that can’t end before Shen arrives. In team fights, after the enemy engages on an ally, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in to slow a carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. After Shen W Spirit's Refuge ends, land the empowered attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to engage. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, you can ignore the first immobilizing effect, but if the canister drops, it may be better to pick it up first. While Shen R Stand United is available, don't chase far just because Shen E Shadow Dash is down.

Singed.watch: Do not chase Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. When Singed R Insanity Potion is active, the poison also reduces healing, so do not follow him relying only on Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage’s healing. Go around areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive, and watch behind Singed so Singed E Fling does not throw you toward the enemy team.
Singed.build: Build magic resistance first and get Spirit Visage early to deal with the magic damage from Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling. The healing Spirit Visage increases works well with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, W Heart Zapper, and R Maximum Dosage. Singed E Fling deals damage based on your maximum health, so do not rely on stacking health alone.
Singed.fight: In the early game, poke with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, but do not follow Singed deep into Singed Q Poison Trail. If Singed W Mega Adhesive and E Fling are on cooldown, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and look for a chance to close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before the enemy’s damage lands, then use Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma at basic attack range.
Singed.laning: Your default plan is to endure, farm CS, and hold the lane with the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases drops a canister, picking it up first may be better than continuing the trade.
Singed.combo: After Singed W Mega Adhesive and E Fling are on cooldown, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in.
