Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Singed’s damage lands, then use the empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma up close. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Singed is within its explosion radius to recover the stored health.
Singed.escape: Singed has no skill that lets him create distance on his own, so the window to close in is when Singed W Mega Adhesive and E Fling are on cooldown. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and the enemy jungler is missing, do not move forward. If Singed retreats while Singed R Insanity Potion is active and leaves poison behind, stop chasing and get out of the trail.
Singed.phase: In the late game, health items also increase the attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, but keep accounting for the maximum-health-based damage from Singed E Fling and the healing reduction from Singed R Insanity Potion.
Singed.teamfight: Do not chase Singed all the way just because he dives onto an ally. After the enemy engages on an ally, enter with Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage, slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and hit them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Go around Singed W Mega Adhesive, and avoid positions where Singed E Fling could throw you into the middle of the enemy team.

Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash becomes dangerous if charged for a long time, as it can knock you up and stun you, so move sideways when he starts charging. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught charges in a straight line, so avoid narrow paths and sidestep. If Sion E Roar of the Slayer hits you, it reduces your armor and slows you, making follow-up attacks hard to avoid, so dodge it first.
Sion.build: Build armor first against the main sources of Sion’s damage: Sion P Glory in Death, Q Decimating Smash, and R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your maximum health, so do not focus your purchases only on health. Even after you build armor, a hit from Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor, so dodging it takes priority.
Sion.fight: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, move sideways to avoid the knock-up and stun, then counterattack. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before the damage lands, then recast it to heal while Sion is within its explosion radius. Right after Sion W Soul Furnace activates, you have a chance to break the shield first and prevent the explosion.
Sion.combo: After dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and approach. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before the enemy’s attack lands, then use an empowered basic attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma at basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Sion is nearby to recover the stored health.
Sion.escape: Your chance to engage comes after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash’s charged attack or when Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is on cooldown. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, you can ignore the first immobilizing effect; if it is down, keep your distance and watch for Sion’s follow-up crowd control.
Sion.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so farm and endure while making sure you do not keep giving Sion CS. In the late game, Mundo’s health items also contribute to the attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, but Sion also builds maximum health through CS, so do not let him scale unchecked.
Sion.teamfight: Position yourself clear of Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught’s straight path, then activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in after Sion engages your allies. Slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and hit them with an empowered attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Sion falls and revives through Sion P Glory in Death, do not keep fighting there; reposition.

Skarner.fight: The moment after Skarner uses Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your chance to close the gap. Slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Skarner’s counterattack lands, then close in and use the empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Skarner is within its explosion radius to heal.
Skarner.combo: Once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is on cooldown, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Skarner’s combo lands, then get within basic attack range and use the empowered basic attack from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Skarner is within its explosion radius.
Skarner.escape: Go in right after you bait Skarner into using Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, you can ignore the first immobilizing effect, but while it is down, Skarner’s crowd control will lock you down, so delay your engage.
Skarner.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so farm CS while avoiding a distance at which Skarner can catch you.
Skarner.teamfight: After Skarner engages your allies, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and enter the fight. Avoid positions where Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale can catch you, slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Be careful near the edges of the Dragon or Baron pit, where Skarner R Impale can pull you in.
Skarner.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand the magic damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone. Also get movement speed so you can walk out of telegraphed areas.

TahmKench.watch: If you keep getting hit by basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste will stack, opening the way for a stun and Tahm Kench R Devour. If you have been hit twice, retreat out of range and wait for the stacks to disappear. When you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, do not bunch up at the landing point.
TahmKench.build: Tahm Kench’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first and get Spirit Visage early, which also helps Dr. Mundo’s healing. If the duel runs long, consider Executioner's Calling to reduce healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin. Keep in mind Tahm Kench R Devour deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about relying on health alone.
TahmKench.fight: Do not force an engage early; start trades when no stacks from Tahm Kench are present or Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is on cooldown. Slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before his counterattack, then use Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma at basic attack range. Tahm Kench can recover from damage with Tahm Kench E Thick Skin, so avoid short trades where you hit him a little and back off.
TahmKench.combo: While no stacks from Tahm Kench are present, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and approach. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before his counterattack, then close in and use an empowered basic attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Tahm Kench is within its explosion radius to recover the stored health.
TahmKench.escape: Once Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is on cooldown, it is harder for him to engage or escape, so close the gap with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw then. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, you can ignore the first immobilizing effect, but if it is down, avoid fights where Tahm Kench can catch you with crowd control.
TahmKench.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so farm and endure. In the late game, health items increase the attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, but manage your distance so Tahm Kench cannot keep you locked down for long.
TahmKench.teamfight: Rather than starting a teamfight, wait until Tahm Kench engages an ally, then activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Instead of wasting your damage on Tahm Kench, slow the carry he is protecting with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and pressure them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Tahm Kench R Devour is available, he can save the carry by swallowing them, so keep up pressure with Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper's area damage while they are swallowed.

Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart also negates Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma empowered basic attacks. While blinded, stop basic attacking and use Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw or back away. Watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare stealth in bushes without vision, and beware Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow passages.
Teemo.build: Since Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap deal most of their damage as magic damage, build magic resistance first. Getting Spirit Visage early gives you magic resistance and also increases the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, and Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage. Consider Frozen Heart if the enemy ranged damage dealers rely on attack speed.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used. Slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw to close the gap, and if you commit, avoid trades where you only take poison damage from Teemo E Toxic Shot before backing away. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before the enemy damage lands, then reactivate it to heal while Teemo is in its explosion radius.
Teemo.laning: Early on, farm behind minions and avoid staying within Teemo’s basic attack range for long. Save Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw for healing rather than poke, and look for an opening to engage when your jungler ganks or just after Teemo uses a spell on the wave. Don’t walk past a bush without vision; use a Control Ward or take another route.
Teemo.combo: Once Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, approach with the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper. Reactivate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Teemo is in its radius, then land an empowered Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma basic attack while you are not blinded.
Teemo.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so focus on surviving against Teemo and collecting CS. As you build health items later, the attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma also increases, so protect the lane time you need to scale.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap from key routes, and move as if there are traps around objectives and in narrow passages. After the enemy engages on your allies, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in, slowing an enemy damage dealer with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. If Teemo Q Blinding Dart hits you, don’t rush your basic attacks; wait for the blind to end, then land an empowered Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma basic attack.
Teemo.escape: Engage after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down so you don’t waste Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered basic attack while blinded. If Teemo W Move Quick is also down, it’s your chance to slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close the gap. If Teemo W Move Quick is still available, you can use the movement speed from Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage to engage.

Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury makes his critical strikes threatening as he builds Fury, so create distance in advance while he hits minions to build it. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before taking damage when Tryndamere E Spinning Slash engages. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t pour more damage into him; back away and let its duration run out.
Tryndamere.build: Build armor first because Tryndamere deals most of his damage as physical damage. Thornmail is also effective against Tryndamere, who relies on basic attacks.
Tryndamere.fight: The moment Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down is your chance to close the gap. Slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and engage, but when he retaliates, absorb the damage with Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper before landing an empowered Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma basic attack. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t force the duel; back away.
Tryndamere.combo: Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper as Tryndamere E Spinning Slash deals damage, then slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and engage. Once you’re in basic attack range, land an empowered Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma basic attack. Reactivate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Tryndamere is in its explosion radius.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after Tryndamere uses E Spinning Slash is your chance to slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and go in. When you need to retreat, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, stop chasing and back away.
Tryndamere.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure, while Tryndamere’s Fury and critical strikes are threatening, so farm and survive. Later, the attack damage bonus from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma grows as you build health items, but don’t take on a side lane fight alone when Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready.
Tryndamere.teamfight: After the enemy engages on your allies, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in. Slow an enemy damage dealer with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and hit them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t focus your damage on him; back away and let it run out.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, Dr. Mundo focuses on farming safely and surviving rather than looking for kills. If Tryndamere attacks minions to build Fury, take that as a sign he may engage and back off. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw can be blocked by minions, so look for an angle to hit Tryndamere; if you need healing, it’s fine to hit a minion.

Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash stuns as he approaches, so let time pass outside basic attack range. If you have to fight, check that Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, sidestep to avoid its damage and slow. Be careful of dives, even under your turret, while Volibear R Stormbringer is available.
Volibear.build: Build armor first to counter the main damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, Volibear W Frenzied Maul, and Volibear R Stormbringer. Lowering his attack speed is also effective because it reduces how often he can basic attack you. Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about building only health. Consider an anti-heal item if the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul is a problem.
Volibear.fight: Early on, focus on surviving and scaling instead of looking for kills. Wait for Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks to fall off and dodge Volibear E Sky Splitter, then start a trade by slowing him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Volibear retaliates, then land an empowered Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma basic attack.
Volibear.laning: Early on, use the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw while farming CS. Don’t take a fight if Volibear is hitting minions to build Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and the enemy jungler is missing, don’t push the lane forward.
Volibear.combo: Slow Volibear with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in, then activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before he retaliates. Get into basic attack range and land an empowered Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma basic attack. Reactivate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Volibear is in its explosion radius to recover the stored health.
Volibear.escape: Volibear Q Thundering Smash being down is an opening to engage, but also check whether Volibear R Stormbringer is still available, since it can help him escape your chase. While Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, you’ll take the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, so don’t force an engage. In particular, look for an opening before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back up.
Volibear.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so farm and survive instead of taking an unnecessary fight with Volibear. Later, the attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma increases as you build health items.
Volibear.teamfight: After Volibear engages on your allies, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Avoid fighting while Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks are full; if possible, engage after they fall off. Slow an enemy damage dealer with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and pressure them with an empowered Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma basic attack.

Urgot.watch: If Urgot E Disdain hits you, you are stunned and can easily take follow-up hits, so avoid his engage angle and keep your distance. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay near him for long. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of its range before you reach the execution threshold.
Urgot.build: Build armor first because Urgot deals most of his damage as physical damage. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of building a lot of health alone. Urgot’s high armor can make Dr. Mundo’s physical damage less effective, so add penetration or look for damage that armor can’t mitigate if you want to deal more damage.
Urgot.laning: Early on, farm behind minions and keep your distance instead of taking a direct fight. Use Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw to heal by hitting minions rather than to poke, and only look for an opening to engage just after Urgot uses a spell on the wave or when your jungler arrives. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and the enemy jungler is missing, don’t push the lane forward.
Urgot.combo: If Urgot E Disdain is down, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and engage, activating Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before he retaliates. Then land an empowered Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma basic attack from basic attack range. Reactivate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to heal while Urgot is in its explosion radius.
Urgot.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to escape on his own, so don’t engage first while Urgot E Disdain is available. Engage just after Urgot E Disdain is used, and if Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, keep your distance in case Urgot locks you down again.
Urgot.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, and melee champions struggle to fight Urgot head-on, so farm and survive. Later, the attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma increases as you build health items, but manage your distance with the maximum-health-based damage from Urgot P Echoing Flames in mind.
Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so stand on the frontline to keep him from pulling your allied damage dealers behind you. After the enemy engages on your allies, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in, slowing an enemy damage dealer with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and hitting them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Urgot P Echoing Flames damage stacks up if you stay near Urgot for long, so watch your distance even while engaging.
Urgot.fight: Right after Urgot E Disdain is used is Dr. Mundo's chance to close the distance. If Urgot approaches with W Purge active, his movement speed is reduced, so walk out of his attack range. If you have to take the fight, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Urgot's damage lands.

Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede dashes quickly and stuns, so watch your distance just after he activates a stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay and trade for long just because you have a lot of health.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm. If the enemy team’s magic damage is a concern, get Spirit Visage earlier for magic resistance and Dr. Mundo’s healing. Don’t rely on stacking health alone, given Udyr’s damage based on your maximum health.
Udyr.fight: Pressure Udyr after the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Udyr’s attack lands, then recast it to heal while Udyr is in the explosion radius. If you’ve already absorbed Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun once, fight back or disengage while he can’t stun the same target again for a while.
Udyr.laning: Early on, focus on farming rather than looking for kills. Use the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits and Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases. Udyr may appear from the jungle for a gank, so ward key paths and jungle entrances, and don’t move forward when he’s missing. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and the enemy jungler is also missing, don’t push the lane forward.
Udyr.combo: Slow Udyr with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, close in, and activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper. At basic attack range, land an empowered attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Udyr’s attack lands, then recast it yourself while Udyr is in range. Apply this pressure after the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone.
Udyr.escape: The moment after you force Udyr to use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close the distance. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases absorbed Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun, fight or disengage while Udyr can’t stun the same target again. Immobilizing effects don’t work during Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s awakened state, so wait until it ends before relying on Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw’s slow to manage your distance.
Udyr.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so farm while watching for Udyr’s ganks.
Udyr.teamfight: After Udyr engages on your team, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and move in. Pressure the vulnerable enemies in the back with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw’s slow and Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Rather than trying to kill Udyr first while he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle, deal with the weaker enemies behind him, then fight with a numbers advantage. Choose your fight timing with the understanding that it’s hard to walk into the backline without Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage.

Trundle.watch: Trundle’s attacks and healing are stronger inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, so move out and wait for it to expire. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape and knocks you away, so fight in open areas and immediately sidestep when the pillar appears. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on your maximum health and steals your resistances, so keep your distance while it’s active.
Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Trundle R Subjugate, and it also steals your resistances, so prioritize getting out of R range over stacking more resistance. Effects that reduce Trundle’s attack speed also help reduce his damage.
Trundle.fight: Move out of Trundle W Frozen Domain and let it expire before trading. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks land, then recast it so Trundle is within its radius when it explodes. Don’t face Trundle alone while Trundle R Subjugate is active.
Trundle.laning: Early on, survive and farm using the healing from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw rather than looking for kills. Trundle P King’s Tribute heals him when nearby units die, so don’t prolong trades that only chip away at his health beside a large wave. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and the enemy jungler is missing, don’t push the lane forward.
Trundle.combo: After Trundle W Frozen Domain ends, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Trundle’s counterattack lands, then use Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma for an empowered attack at basic attack range. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Trundle is in the explosion radius.
Trundle.phase: Early on, Trundle’s base attack damage is high and Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure, so farm and survive. In midgame, once Dr. Mundo has Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and his first core item, his staying power improves, but avoid facing Trundle alone in a side lane after Trundle gains Trundle R Subjugate. In the late game, both Dr. Mundo’s health and the attack damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma increase, so choose a team fight around an objective rather than matching Trundle alone.
Trundle.teamfight: After Trundle engages on your team, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Slow an enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, then attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, don’t face Trundle alone on the frontline; target someone else or create distance.
Trundle.escape: The opening comes after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is used and Trundle W Frozen Domain expires. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so use the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw to close in then. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is used by Trundle E Pillar of Ice, don’t force the chase.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his tornado engage is ready, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear. After Yone uses Yone E Soul Unbound to engage, he deals extra damage when he returns, so be ready to heal with Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper or Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage before health drops.
Yone.build: Get movement speed first so you can walk out of Yone’s telegraphed attack range. Yone deals a mix of physical and magic damage, so build both resistances instead of focusing on one. Also consider reducing his attack speed to slow how often Yone Q Mortal Steel comes back.
Yone.fight: Keep your distance while Yone’s tornado Q Mortal Steel is ready, and counterattack after he uses his engage skill. If Yone dives in, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before his attack, then slow him with Q Infected Bonesaw and hit him with E Blunt Force Trauma.
Yone.laning: Early on, Dr. Mundo should prioritize CS and survival over kills, and wait outside the range of Yone’s tornado Q Mortal Steel while Yone prepares it. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw can still heal you even if it’s blocked by a minion, so use it to hold the lane. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and the enemy jungler is missing, don’t push the lane forward.
Yone.combo: When Yone goes in, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper to store damage, slow him with Q Infected Bonesaw and close in, then land an empowered basic attack with E Blunt Force Trauma.
Yone.escape: Don’t go deep just because Yone has used only one of Yone Q Mortal Steel, Yone E Soul Unbound, or Yone R Fate Sealed. In particular, wait for a window before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back when his other mobility options are also down, then slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in.
Yone.phase: Yone is also weak early, but Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure, so focus on farming and surviving instead of taking risky fights. In the late game, the more health items Dr. Mundo has, the more attack damage he gains from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so multiple people aren’t hit by Yone W Spirit Cleave, and check whether you’re standing furthest back in the formation Yone R Fate Sealed will hit. After Yone engages on your team, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in. Slow an enemy carry with Q Infected Bonesaw, then attack with E Blunt Force Trauma.

Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you, lowers your resistances, and deals damage based on your maximum health. Dodge its arc, and if it hits, create distance from Yorick himself. If Yorick W Dark Procession traps you, attack the wall to break it.
Yorick.build: Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers’ attacks deal physical damage, so build armor first. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If the enemy team has a lot of magic damage, get Spirit Visage earlier for magic resistance and more healing for Dr. Mundo.
Yorick.fight: Don’t start a fight where there are lots of graves and Mist Walkers; clear the Mist Walkers first. After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Yorick’s attack lands, then use Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma once you’re in basic attack range.
Yorick.combo: If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before the enemy’s attack lands, then get close and land an empowered basic attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Recast Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper while Yorick is in the explosion radius to heal.
Yorick.escape: The moment after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist is your chance to engage. Yorick has no skill to create distance on his own, so after clearing the Mist Walkers and closing in, you can keep pressuring him. If Yorick W Dark Procession traps you, attack the wall to break it, and don’t engage recklessly while Dr. Mundo’s passive is down.
Yorick.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so farm and survive without fighting where Yorick has built up graves. In the late game, the more health items Dr. Mundo has, the more attack damage he gains from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, but keep watching for Yorick’s damage based on your maximum health.
Yorick.teamfight: Rather than starting teamfights, Dr. Mundo should wait until the enemy, including Yorick, engages his allies, then activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and go in. Slow the enemy carries with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Yorick is pushing a side lane, also consider trading by taking an objective elsewhere with your allies.

Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo lands Q Steel Tempest twice, the next tornado knocks you airborne. If he has two stacks, move out of its path and dodge to the side. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the gap, so don’t stand among minions for long. Save Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw when you are in front of Yasuo W Wind Wall; change your angle or wait for the wall to disappear.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first to withstand the main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Remember that armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: Use light poke to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before starting a trade. Just after Yasuo’s tornado misses, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before his combo lands. If health has dropped, use Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage to heal before dying.
Yasuo.laning: Early on, focus on staying alive and farming rather than getting kills. Keep the wave thin and toward your side to limit Yasuo E Sweeping Blade’s approach routes through minions. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by minions, so if there’s no clear path to hit Yasuo, hit a minion to heal. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and the enemy jungler is missing, don’t push the lane forward.
Yasuo.combo: Remove Yasuo’s shield, and once his tornado is down, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper just before Yasuo retaliates, then land a basic attack empowered by Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma within basic attack range. Recast W while Yasuo is in the blast radius to recover the health you stored.
Yasuo.escape: Look for an engage just after Yasuo throws his tornado, while his knock-up is briefly unavailable. Don’t immediately chase deep just because Yasuo has used E Sweeping Blade alone. Engage before Yasuo R Last Breath becomes available again and when crowd control can also be applied.
Yasuo.phase: Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure early, so farm and hold on instead of forcing a kill on Yasuo. Later, as you build health items, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma grants more attack damage, so join fights once you’ve grown stronger.
Yasuo.teamfight: Instead of starting the team fight, wait for Yasuo to engage on your allies, then activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in. Slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and hit them with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks Q’s path, reposition or throw it after the wall disappears.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, Gnar E Hop / Crunch, and Gnar R GNAR! Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone. Dr. Mundo has no mobility, so consider tenacity to prepare for Mega Gnar’s wall stun.
Gnar.combo: After Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and close in. Just before Gnar’s counterattack lands, activate Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, then land Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered attack in basic attack range. Recast W for healing when Gnar is within its blast radius.
Gnar.escape: Your chance to close in comes right after you bait out Gnar E Hop / Crunch. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is active, you can ignore the first immobilizing effect and close in; if it has been used, watch out for Mega Gnar’s crowd control.
Gnar.fight: Don’t force an approach while Mini Gnar is harassing you at range; look for an opening just after he reverts from Mega to Mini. If Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, slow him with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, close in, and take a short trade. After Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar, don’t fight head-on; create distance.
Gnar.phase: Early on, Dr. Mundo has little kill pressure, while Mini Gnar can harass from range, so focus on farming without forcing a fight. In the late game, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma gains more attack damage as you build health items, so make use of your scaling while watching Gnar’s transformation cycle.
Gnar.teamfight: Don’t start a fight with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain where Mega Gnar R GNAR! can knock you into a wall and stun you. After Gnar engages on your allies, activate Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage and walk in; slow the enemy carry with Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and attack with Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Gnar has just reverted from Mega to Mini, coordinate with your team to take advantage of the window before he can transform again.
Gnar.watch: The boomerang from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit both on the way out and on the way back, so step out of its path. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals damage based on your max health, and Mega Gnar R GNAR! stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so avoid fighting with your back to one.
Gnar.laning: Early on, farm behind minions and use Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw to heal. Only look for an angle to close in right after Gnar uses an ability on the wave or when your jungler is ganking. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases has been used and you can’t see the enemy jungler, don’t push the wave forward.
